metadata.description: QA workflow plugins for Claude Code: test design, bug investigation and test automation.

plugins.name: qa-test-design
plugins.description: Design structured manual test cases from requirements, user stories or acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: qa-bug-investigation
plugins.description: Write clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira format, created only after user approval.

plugins.name: qa-bug-retest
plugins.description: Daily QA flow: re-check every open Jira bug in the browser and report which are still happening, look fixed or changed.
